# Certified Drug Test Centers (CDTC)

> Certified Drug Test Centers (CDTC) is a premier nationwide diagnostic screening network providing CLIA & SAMHSA certified drug, alcohol, DNA, DOT transportation compliance, and occupational health testing. Partnering with SAMHSA-certified laboratories (Quest Diagnostics and Labcorp) across over 20,000 collection sites in all 50 U.S. states and Washington D.C., CDTC delivers secure, same-day electronic donor authorization passes.

## Core Capabilities & Trust Standards
- **Accreditation**: All specimen analysis is performed exclusively by SAMHSA and CLIA-certified clinical laboratories.
- **Medical Review Officer (MRO)**: Every laboratory screen is independently reviewed and verified by a licensed MRO to safeguard accuracy and eliminate legitimate medical false positives.
- **Speed**: Electronic Donor Passes with barcodes are issued instantly via email or text upon registration. Negative screening results are typically returned within 24 to 48 business hours.
- **Convenience**: Thousands of convenient certified collection sites nationwide (Monday - Friday 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM local time).
- **Compliance & Legal Admissibility**: Strict Chain of Custody (CoC) protocols suitable for federal DOT, court-mandated (probation, custody, litigation), and employer drug-free workplace standards.

## Primary Diagnostic Services & Panels

### Urine Drug Testing Panels
- [5 Panel NON-DOT Drug Test](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/5-panel-nondot): Screens for Marijuana (THC), Cocaine, Basic Opiates, Amphetamines, and Phencyclidine (PCP). ($89.99, 24-48 hrs).
- [5 Panel Rapid Drug Test](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/5-panel-rapid-results): Instant results on-site for rapid employment screening. ($99.99, Instant).
- [10 Panel Drug Screening](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/10-panel): Comprehensive test adding Benzodiazepines, Barbiturates, Methadone, and Propoxyphene. ($109.99, 24-48 hrs).
- [12 Panel Comprehensive Screen](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/12-panel-comprehensive): Extended workplace screen including Meperidine/Demerol and Oxycodone/Percocet. ($139.99, 24-48 hrs).

### DOT & Transportation Compliance
- [5 Panel DOT Drug Test](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/5-panel-dot): Mandatory 49 CFR Part 40 federal testing for FMCSA, FAA, FRA, FTA, PHMSA, and USCG safety-sensitive employees. ($99.99).
- [DOT Physical Examination (NRCME)](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/dot-physical): Performed by certified NRCME medical examiners; includes medical certificate. ($159.99).
- [DOT Random Consortium Pool](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/1-year-consortium-membership-dot-drug-test): 1-Year random testing pool enrollment & compliance certificate. ($249.99).
- [FMCSA Clearinghouse Support](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/fmcsa-clearinghouse-accucheck): Driver query processing, registration, and violation reporting. ($199.99).

### Specialized & Extended Screening
- [Hair Follicle Drug Testing](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/category/hair): Extended 90-day lookback window for long-term pattern detection (1.5 inch specimen).
- [EtG Alcohol Testing (Urine & Hair)](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/product/etg-alcohol): Ethyl Glucuronide metabolite detection covering up to 80 hours after consumption ($119.99).
- [Background Checks & MVR Reports](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/background-checks): Pre-employment criminal background checks and Motor Vehicle Records.
- [Mobile & On-Site Testing](https://certifieddrugtestingcenters.com/category/on-site-mobile): Mobile collector dispatch for groups of 10+ employees.

## How Testing Works (3-Step Protocol)
1. **Order & Register Online or via Phone**: Choose your required test and register donor details. Collection facilities do NOT take payments on-site.
2. **Instant Electronic Pass Issued**: Receive your electronic donor pass via email or text containing the testing center address, hours, and barcode.
3. **Visit Collection Center**: Visit the assigned collection site during collection hours with your pass and a government-issued photo ID.
